m: Curly Creek & Miller Creek Falls Trail

t.name: Lemei Trail #34
t.description: This 5.3 mile trail offers views of Mounts Adams, Rainier, St. Helens, and Hood, along with views of Lemei Rock, a 5,925' promontory that juts 500' above Lake Wapiki.

t.name: Deep Lake Trail #33A
t.description: A short trail that accesses Deep Lake off of the Indian Heaven Trail #33 within Indian Heaven Wilderness.

t.name: Cultus Creek Trail #108
t.description: This popular 1.5 mile trail begins at Cultus Creek Campground/Trailhead and enters Indian Heaven Wilderness.

t.name: Indian Heaven Trail #33
t.description: From the trailhead at Cultus Creek Campground this 3.3 mile trail climbs steeply through heavy timber into Indian Heaven Wilderness.

t.name: Thomas Lake Trail #111
t.description: This 3.3 mile heavily used trail passes numerous lakes prior to its connection with the Pacific Crest National Scenic Trail #2000 within Indian Heaven Wilderness.

t.name: East Crater Trail #48
t.description: This moderately used trail is one of the main access routes from the east into the central part of Indian Heaven Wilderness. Trail features include small lakes, ponds, marshes, meadows, wildflowers, and Junction Lake.

t.name: Wood Lake Trail #185
t.description: This trail lies in the northern section of Indian Heaven Wilderness. The trail begins on the Pacific Crest National Scenic Trail north of the junction with Cultus Creek Trail #108. It descends through semi-open areas to the edge of Wood Lake.

t.name: Chenamus Lake Trail #29A
t.description: Located in the north portion of the Indian Heaven Wilderness, Chenamus Trail #29A begins at the northeast end of Placid Lake via Placid Lake Trail #29. It proceeds part way around the lake then climbs south to Chenamus Lake.

t.name: Placid Lake Trail #29
t.description: This heavily used trail begins on the northwest side of Indian Heaven Wilderness. Placid Lake, meadows, wildflowers, and a small lake are features along this trail.

t.name: Hand Shake Trail #67
t.description: This is a short, accessible trail that leads to monument honoring the Hand Shake agreement of 1932.

t.name: Sawtooth Mountain Trail #107
t.description: This trail is a former section of the Pacific Crest Trail which was relocated to skirt the lower west flank Sawtooth Mountain. The trail climbs to near the top of the mountain providing wonderful views of Mt. Adams, Mt. Rainier and Mt. St. Helens.

t.name: Elk Lake Trail #176
t.description: Located in the mid-section of Indian Heaven Wilderness, this short trail takes off from the Pacific Crest Trail near Bear Lake and drops down to Elk Lake (4,685' elevation). This trail offers fishing opportunities in Elk Lake and Bear Lake.

t.name: Lemei Lake Trail #179
t.description: Beginning at Indian Heaven Trail #33 near Clear Lake, the trail travels south past Lemei Lake. It ends at the Pacific Crest Trail near Junction Lake (4,730' elevation).

t.name: Terminator Trail #159
t.description: This 4.2 mile trail is mainly a winter cross-country ski trail, and makes a loop when combined with McClellan Trail #157.
